content.json:
# 🧹 Stale & Orphaned Resource Finder
Finds Azure resources that are provisioned but unused — unattached disks, orphan IPs/NICs/NSGs, empty App Service plans, stopped VMs, old snapshots and empty resource groups.

Select subscriptions and a staleness threshold below, then work through the tabs.

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.query: resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups' | project value = tolower(name), label = name | order by label asc

content.json: 💰 **Estimated unit prices** — defaults are approximate US East list prices. Adjust to match your region, currency and any discounts (EA/CSP/reservations). All cost columns are *estimates*, not billed amounts; the **Cost** tab pulls real month-to-date spend from Cost Management.

## Stale & orphaned Azure resources
Resources that are provisioned but not doing useful work. Use the tabs to drill into each category, then export to Excel for clean-up tracking.

> Data source: Azure Resource Graph (near real-time). Always validate with the resource owner before deleting anything.

content.query:
resources
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| extend Flagged = case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached', 1,
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and isnull(properties.ipConfiguration) and isnull(properties.natGateway), 1,
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/networkinterfaces' and isnull(properties.virtualMachine) and isnull(properties.privateEndpoint), 1,
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups' and isnull(properties.networkInterfaces) and isnull(properties.subnets), 1,
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots' and todatetime(properties.timeCreated) < ago({StaleDays}d), 1,
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and toint(properties.numberOfSites) == 0, 1,
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and array_length(properties.backendAddressPools) == 0, 1,
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and array_length(properties.backendAddressPools) == 0, 1,
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code) =~ 'PowerState/stopped', 1,
    0)
| where Flagged == 1
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * case(tostring(sku.name) has 'Ultra', todouble('{PriceDiskUltra}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'Premium', todouble('{PriceDiskPremium}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'StandardSSD', todouble('{PriceDiskSSD}'), todouble('{PriceDiskHDD}')),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * todouble('{PriceSnapshot}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', todouble('{PricePublicIP}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', todouble('{PriceLB}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', todouble('{PriceAppGw}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', todouble(coalesce(toint(sku.capacity),1)) * case(tostring(sku.tier) has 'Isolated', todouble('{PricePlanIsolated}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Premium', todouble('{PricePlanPremium}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Standard', todouble('{PricePlanStandard}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Basic', todouble('{PricePlanBasic}'), 0.0),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', todouble('{PriceVMHour}') * 730.0,
    0.0), 2)
| summarize ['Stale resources'] = count(),
            ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(sum(['Est. monthly cost']), 2),
            ['Est. annual cost'] = round(sum(['Est. monthly cost']) * 12, 2),
            ['Unattached disk GB'] = sum(iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks', toint(properties.diskSizeGB), 0))
content.title: Headline — estimated waste ({Currency})

content.query:
resources
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| extend cat = case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached', 'Unattached managed disks',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and isnull(properties.ipConfiguration) and isnull(properties.natGateway), 'Unassociated public IPs',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/networkinterfaces' and isnull(properties.virtualMachine) and isnull(properties.privateEndpoint), 'Unattached network interfaces',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups' and isnull(properties.networkInterfaces) and isnull(properties.subnets), 'Unused NSGs',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/routetables' and isnull(properties.subnets), 'Unused route tables',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots' and todatetime(properties.timeCreated) < ago({StaleDays}d), 'Snapshots older than {StaleDays}d',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/availabilitysets' and array_length(properties.virtualMachines) == 0, 'Empty availability sets',
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and toint(properties.numberOfSites) == 0, 'App Service plans with no apps',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and array_length(properties.backendAddressPools) == 0, 'Load balancers with no backend',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and array_length(properties.backendAddressPools) == 0, 'App Gateways with no backend',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code) =~ 'PowerState/stopped', 'VMs stopped (still billed)',
    '')
| where isnotempty(cat)
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * case(tostring(sku.name) has 'Ultra', todouble('{PriceDiskUltra}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'Premium', todouble('{PriceDiskPremium}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'StandardSSD', todouble('{PriceDiskSSD}'), todouble('{PriceDiskHDD}')),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * todouble('{PriceSnapshot}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', todouble('{PricePublicIP}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', todouble('{PriceLB}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', todouble('{PriceAppGw}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', todouble(coalesce(toint(sku.capacity),1)) * case(tostring(sku.tier) has 'Isolated', todouble('{PricePlanIsolated}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Premium', todouble('{PricePlanPremium}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Standard', todouble('{PricePlanStandard}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Basic', todouble('{PricePlanBasic}'), 0.0),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', todouble('{PriceVMHour}') * 730.0,
    0.0), 2)
| summarize Resources = count(), ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(sum(['Est. monthly cost']), 2) by ['Stale category'] = cat
| order by ['Est. monthly cost'] desc
content.title: Estimated monthly waste by category ({Currency})

content.query:
resources
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| where (type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached')
    or (type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and isnull(properties.ipConfiguration))
    or (type =~ 'microsoft.network/networkinterfaces' and isnull(properties.virtualMachine) and isnull(properties.privateEndpoint))
    or (type =~ 'microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups' and isnull(properties.networkInterfaces) and isnull(properties.subnets))
    or (type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots' and todatetime(properties.timeCreated) < ago({StaleDays}d))
    or (type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and toint(properties.numberOfSites) == 0)
    or (type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and array_length(properties.backendAddressPools) == 0)
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * case(tostring(sku.name) has 'Ultra', todouble('{PriceDiskUltra}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'Premium', todouble('{PriceDiskPremium}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'StandardSSD', todouble('{PriceDiskSSD}'), todouble('{PriceDiskHDD}')),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * todouble('{PriceSnapshot}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', todouble('{PricePublicIP}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', todouble('{PriceLB}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', todouble('{PriceAppGw}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', todouble(coalesce(toint(sku.capacity),1)) * case(tostring(sku.tier) has 'Isolated', todouble('{PricePlanIsolated}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Premium', todouble('{PricePlanPremium}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Standard', todouble('{PricePlanStandard}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Basic', todouble('{PricePlanBasic}'), 0.0),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', todouble('{PriceVMHour}') * 730.0,
    0.0), 2)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, SubName = name) on subscriptionId
| summarize ['Stale resources'] = count(), ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(sum(['Est. monthly cost']), 2) by Subscription = coalesce(SubName, subscriptionId)
| order by ['Est. monthly cost'] desc
content.title: Estimated monthly waste by subscription ({Currency})

content.query:
resources
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| extend Reason = case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached', 'Unattached managed disk',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and isnull(properties.ipConfiguration) and isnull(properties.natGateway), 'Unassociated public IP',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/networkinterfaces' and isnull(properties.virtualMachine) and isnull(properties.privateEndpoint), 'Unattached NIC',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups' and isnull(properties.networkInterfaces) and isnull(properties.subnets), 'NSG not associated',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/routetables' and isnull(properties.subnets), 'Route table not associated',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots' and todatetime(properties.timeCreated) < ago({StaleDays}d), 'Snapshot older than {StaleDays} days',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/availabilitysets' and array_length(properties.virtualMachines) == 0, 'Empty availability set',
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and toint(properties.numberOfSites) == 0, 'App Service plan with no apps',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and array_length(properties.backendAddressPools) == 0, 'Load balancer with no backend pool',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and array_length(properties.backendAddressPools) == 0, 'Application gateway with no backend pool',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code) =~ 'PowerState/stopped', 'VM stopped but not deallocated',
    '')
| where isnotempty(Reason)
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * case(tostring(sku.name) has 'Ultra', todouble('{PriceDiskUltra}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'Premium', todouble('{PriceDiskPremium}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'StandardSSD', todouble('{PriceDiskSSD}'), todouble('{PriceDiskHDD}')),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * todouble('{PriceSnapshot}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', todouble('{PricePublicIP}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', todouble('{PriceLB}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', todouble('{PriceAppGw}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', todouble(coalesce(toint(sku.capacity),1)) * case(tostring(sku.tier) has 'Isolated', todouble('{PricePlanIsolated}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Premium', todouble('{PricePlanPremium}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Standard', todouble('{PricePlanStandard}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Basic', todouble('{PricePlanBasic}'), 0.0),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', todouble('{PriceVMHour}') * 730.0,
    0.0), 2)
| project Name = name, Reason, Type = type, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, ['Open resource'] = id, Tags = tags, ['Est. monthly cost']
| order by ['Est. monthly cost'] desc, Reason asc
content.title: All flagged resources

content.json:
## Cost

**Estimated cost** columns across the workbook use the editable unit prices at the top — good enough for prioritising clean-up, not for billing.

**Actual cost** below calls Azure Cost Management live. It needs *Cost Management Reader* (or Billing Reader) on the selected subscription, and works one subscription at a time.

content.query:
resources
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| extend Reason = case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached', 'Unattached managed disk',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and isnull(properties.ipConfiguration) and isnull(properties.natGateway), 'Unassociated public IP',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots' and todatetime(properties.timeCreated) < ago({StaleDays}d), 'Old snapshot',
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and toint(properties.numberOfSites) == 0, 'Empty App Service plan',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and array_length(properties.backendAddressPools) == 0, 'Load balancer without backend',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and array_length(properties.backendAddressPools) == 0, 'App gateway without backend',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code) =~ 'PowerState/stopped', 'VM stopped but not deallocated',
    '')
| where isnotempty(Reason)
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * case(tostring(sku.name) has 'Ultra', todouble('{PriceDiskUltra}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'Premium', todouble('{PriceDiskPremium}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'StandardSSD', todouble('{PriceDiskSSD}'), todouble('{PriceDiskHDD}')),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * todouble('{PriceSnapshot}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', todouble('{PricePublicIP}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', todouble('{PriceLB}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', todouble('{PriceAppGw}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', todouble(coalesce(toint(sku.capacity),1)) * case(tostring(sku.tier) has 'Isolated', todouble('{PricePlanIsolated}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Premium', todouble('{PricePlanPremium}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Standard', todouble('{PricePlanStandard}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Basic', todouble('{PricePlanBasic}'), 0.0),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', todouble('{PriceVMHour}') * 730.0,
    0.0), 2)
| project Name = name, Reason, Type = type, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, ['Est. monthly cost'], ['Est. annual cost'] = round(['Est. monthly cost'] * 12, 2), ['Open resource'] = id
| order by ['Est. monthly cost'] desc
content.title: Estimated monthly & annual savings by resource ({Currency})

content.json:
## Compute
VMs left in a **Stopped** (not deallocated) state still incur compute charges. Deallocate or delete them.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| extend PowerState = tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.displayStatus)
| where PowerState !has 'deallocated' and PowerState !has 'running'
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(todouble('{PriceVMHour}') * 730.0, 2)
| project Name = name, VM = id, PowerState, Size = tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, Tags = tags, ['Est. monthly cost']
| order by ['Resource group'] asc
content.title: VMs stopped but not deallocated

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| extend PowerState = tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.displayStatus)
| where PowerState has 'deallocated'
| project Name = name, VM = id, PowerState, Size = tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location
| order by VM asc
content.title: Deallocated VMs (idle capacity — disks still billed)

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/availabilitysets'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| where array_length(properties.virtualMachines) == 0
| project Name = name, ['Availability set'] = id, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location
content.title: Empty availability sets

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| extend Capacity = toint(sku.capacity)
| where Capacity == 0
| project Name = name, ['Scale set'] = id, Capacity, SKU = tostring(sku.name), ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location
content.title: Virtual machine scale sets with zero instances

content.json:
## Storage & disks
Unattached disks and ageing snapshots/images are the most common source of silent spend.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| where tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached'
| extend SizeGB = toint(properties.diskSizeGB), SKU = tostring(sku.name), Created = todatetime(properties.timeCreated)
| extend ['Age (days)'] = toint(datetime_diff('day', now(), Created))
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(toreal(SizeGB) * case(SKU has 'Ultra', todouble('{PriceDiskUltra}'), SKU has 'Premium', todouble('{PriceDiskPremium}'), SKU has 'StandardSSD', todouble('{PriceDiskSSD}'), todouble('{PriceDiskHDD}')), 2)
| project Name = name, Disk = id, SizeGB, SKU, Created, ['Age (days)'], ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, Tags = tags, ['Est. monthly cost']
| order by ['Est. monthly cost'] desc
content.title: Unattached managed disks

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached'
| summarize ['Total GB'] = sum(toint(properties.diskSizeGB)), Disks = count() by SKU = tostring(sku.name)
| order by ['Total GB'] desc
content.title: Unattached disk capacity by SKU

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| extend Created = todatetime(properties.timeCreated)
| where Created < ago({StaleDays}d)
| extend ['Age (days)'] = toint(datetime_diff('day', now(), Created)), SizeGB = toint(properties.diskSizeGB)
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(toreal(SizeGB) * todouble('{PriceSnapshot}'), 2)
| project Name = name, Snapshot = id, Created, ['Age (days)'], SizeGB, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, ['Est. monthly cost']
| order by ['Age (days)'] desc
content.title: Snapshots older than {StaleDays} days

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/images' or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/galleries/images/versions'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| extend Created = todatetime(properties.publishingProfile.publishedDate)
| project Name = name, Image = id, Type = type, Created, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location
| order by Image asc
content.title: Custom images older than {StaleDays} days

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| extend PublicBlob = tostring(properties.allowBlobPublicAccess), MinTls = tostring(properties.minimumTlsVersion), Created = todatetime(properties.creationTime)
| extend ['Age (days)'] = toint(datetime_diff('day', now(), Created))
| project Name = name, ['Storage account'] = id, PublicBlob, MinTls, Created, ['Age (days)'], ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location
| order by ['Age (days)'] desc
content.title: Storage accounts allowing public blob access / legacy TLS (review candidates)

content.json:
## Networking
Orphaned IPs, NICs, NSGs, gateways and empty subnets.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| where isnull(properties.ipConfiguration) and isnull(properties.natGateway)
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = iff(tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Basic', todouble('{PricePublicIP}'), todouble('{PricePublicIP}'))
| project Name = name, ['Public IP'] = id, SKU = tostring(sku.name), Tier = tostring(sku.tier), Allocation = tostring(properties.publicIPAllocationMethod), Address = tostring(properties.ipAddress), ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, ['Est. monthly cost']
| order by ['Est. monthly cost'] desc
content.title: Unassociated public IP addresses

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/networkinterfaces'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| where isnull(properties.virtualMachine) and isnull(properties.privateEndpoint)
| project Name = name, NIC = id, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, Tags = tags
content.title: Unattached network interfaces

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| where isnull(properties.networkInterfaces) and isnull(properties.subnets)
| project Name = name, NSG = id, Rules = array_length(properties.securityRules), ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location
content.title: Network security groups with no association

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/routetables'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| where isnull(properties.subnets) or array_length(properties.subnets) == 0
| project Name = name, ['Route table'] = id, Routes = array_length(properties.routes), ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location
content.title: Route tables with no subnet association

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.network/loadbalancers','microsoft.network/applicationgateways')
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| where array_length(properties.backendAddressPools) == 0
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', todouble('{PriceAppGw}'), todouble('{PriceLB}'))
| project Name = name, Resource = id, Type = type, SKU = tostring(sku.name), ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, ['Est. monthly cost']
content.title: Load balancers and application gateways with no backend targets

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworks'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| mv-expand subnet = properties.subnets
| summarize Subnets = count(), UsedSubnets = countif(array_length(subnet.properties.ipConfigurations) > 0) by Name = name, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, ['Open resource'] = id
| where UsedSubnets == 0
| project Name, Subnets, ['Resource group'], Location, ['Open resource']
| order by Name asc
content.title: Empty virtual networks (no subnets in use)

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/privateendpoints'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| mv-expand conn = properties.privateLinkServiceConnections
| extend Status = tostring(conn.properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status)
| where Status !~ 'Approved'
| project Name = name, Status, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, ['Open resource'] = id
| order by Name asc
content.title: Private endpoints in a disconnected / rejected state

content.json:
## App & data services
Empty plans, stopped web apps and unused data services.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| where toint(properties.numberOfSites) == 0
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(todouble(coalesce(toint(sku.capacity),1)) * case(tostring(sku.tier) has 'Isolated', todouble('{PricePlanIsolated}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Premium', todouble('{PricePlanPremium}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Standard', todouble('{PricePlanStandard}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Basic', todouble('{PricePlanBasic}'), 0.0), 2)
| project Name = name, Plan = id, SKU = tostring(sku.name), Tier = tostring(sku.tier), Workers = toint(sku.capacity), ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, ['Est. monthly cost']
| order by ['Est. monthly cost'] desc
content.title: App Service plans with no apps

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')

| project Name = name, App = id, State, Kind = kind, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location

resources

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.keyvault/vaults','microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces','microsoft.appconfiguration/configurationstores')
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')

content.json:
## Resources with no configuration change
Uses the Resource Graph **change history** (retained for 14 days for `resourcechanges`; the query below flags resources whose last recorded change is older than the window, i.e. untouched). Combine with cost and activity-log data before acting.

content.query:
resources
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| project id, name, type, resourceGroup, location, subscriptionId, tags
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcechanges
    | extend changeTime = todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp), targetId = tolower(tostring(properties.targetResourceId))
    | summarize LastChange = max(changeTime) by id = targetId
) on $left.id == $right.id
| where isnull(LastChange)
| project Name = name, Type = type, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, ['Last change'] = 'No change in retention window', ['Open resource'] = id, Tags = tags
| order by Type asc, Name asc
content.title: Resources with no change recorded in the last 14 days

content.query:
resourcechanges
| extend changeTime = todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp),
         targetId = tostring(properties.targetResourceId),
         changeType = tostring(properties.changeType),
         changedBy = tostring(properties.changeAttributes.changedBy)
| where changeTime > ago(14d)
| extend Name = tostring(split(targetId, '/')[-1]), ['Resource group'] = tostring(split(targetId, '/')[4])
| project changeTime, Name, ['Resource group'], ['Change type'] = changeType, ['Changed by'] = changedBy, ['Open resource'] = targetId
| order by changeTime desc
| take 200
content.title: Recent changes (last 14 days) — what is actually active

content.query:
resources
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isnull(tags) or array_length(bag_keys(tags)) == 0
| summarize Resources = count() by Type = type
| order by Resources desc
| take 25
content.title: Resources with no tags (ownership unknown)

content.json: ## Empty resource groups & orphan clean-up list

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups'
| extend rgKey = tolower(id)
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | extend rgKey = tolower(strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId, '/resourcegroups/', resourceGroup))
    | summarize Resources = count() by rgKey
) on rgKey
| extend Resources = coalesce(Resources, 0)
| where Resources == 0
| project Name = name, Location = location, Resources, ['Open resource'] = id, Tags = tags
| order by Name asc
content.title: Empty resource groups

content.query:
resources
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or isnull(tags) or not(bag_keys(tags) has '{TagName}')
| extend Reason = case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached', 'Unattached managed disk',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and isnull(properties.ipConfiguration) and isnull(properties.natGateway), 'Unassociated public IP',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/networkinterfaces' and isnull(properties.virtualMachine) and isnull(properties.privateEndpoint), 'Unattached NIC',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups' and isnull(properties.networkInterfaces) and isnull(properties.subnets), 'NSG not associated',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/routetables' and isnull(properties.subnets), 'Route table not associated',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots' and todatetime(properties.timeCreated) < ago({StaleDays}d), 'Old snapshot',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/availabilitysets' and array_length(properties.virtualMachines) == 0, 'Empty availability set',
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and toint(properties.numberOfSites) == 0, 'Empty App Service plan',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and array_length(properties.backendAddressPools) == 0, 'Load balancer without backend',
    '')
| where isnotempty(Reason)
| extend Owner = tostring(tags['Owner']), CostCenter = tostring(tags['CostCenter'])
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * case(tostring(sku.name) has 'Ultra', todouble('{PriceDiskUltra}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'Premium', todouble('{PriceDiskPremium}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'StandardSSD', todouble('{PriceDiskSSD}'), todouble('{PriceDiskHDD}')),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * todouble('{PriceSnapshot}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', todouble('{PricePublicIP}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', todouble('{PriceLB}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', todouble('{PriceAppGw}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', todouble(coalesce(toint(sku.capacity),1)) * case(tostring(sku.tier) has 'Isolated', todouble('{PricePlanIsolated}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Premium', todouble('{PricePlanPremium}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Standard', todouble('{PricePlanStandard}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Basic', todouble('{PricePlanBasic}'), 0.0),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', todouble('{PriceVMHour}') * 730.0,
    0.0), 2)
| project Name = name, Reason, Type = type, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, Owner, CostCenter, ResourceId = id, ['Est. monthly cost']
| order by ['Est. monthly cost'] desc, Reason asc
content.title: Clean-up worklist (all orphans, export to Excel)
